Ahmed is pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering at Sir Syed University of Engineering & Technology (SSUET), starting in March 2025. He also holds certifications from freeCodeCamp, Simplilearn, and Great Learning.

Yes, Ahmed has experience integrating interactive 3D assets and animation libraries into web applications using React Three Fiber, Three.js, and Framer Motion.

### How can I reach out to Ahmed for collaboration?

Ahmed can be reached via email at ahmedsajid1506@gmail.com, through his personal website, or via his LinkedIn profile.

### Is Ahmed available for work?

Yes! Ahmed is actively taking on new client projects, full-stack contract work, and technical collaborations. You can reach out directly via the contact form or email [ahmedsajid1506@gmail.com] to discuss details and timelines.

# Technical Skills

## Frontend Development

- **React & Next.js**: Ahmed uses React and Next.js to build modern, server-side rendered, and performant web applications with structured routing and optimal SEO capabilities.
- **HTML & CSS**: Foundation tools utilized to build accessible and structured interfaces.
- **Three.js & React Three Fiber**: Utilized to create interactive 3D web experiences and visual storytelling components.
- **Framer Motion**: Applied to introduce smooth UI animations and fluid interactive elements.

## Backend Development & APIs

- **Node.js & Express.js**: Used to build secure, scalable backend architectures, server-side logic, and RESTful APIs.
- **RESTful APIs**: Ahmed designs, documents, and consumes RESTful APIs to facilitate communication between client applications and backends.
- **Postman**: Employed for testing, debugging, and documenting backend API endpoints.

## Databases

- **MongoDB**: NoSQL database used for flexible schema design and managing document-oriented application data.
- **MySQL**: Relational database used for structured data storage, querying, and relational data handling.

## Styling & Component Libraries

- **Tailwind CSS**: Primary utility-first CSS framework used for building responsive, pixel-perfect user interfaces.
- **Bootstrap**: Used for structuring responsive design layouts and components.
- **shadcn/ui & Radix UI**: Accessible, customizable component primitives utilized for styling and layout structures.

## CMS & Content Management

- **Sanity CMS**: Integrated as a headless content management platform to enable client-managed dynamic content.

## Authentication & Payments

- **Clerk**: Implemented for seamless user authentication and session management.
- **JWT**: Used for secure token-based backend authentication.
- **Stripe**: Integrated to process secure payment flows and customer transaction workflows.

## State Management

- **Zustand**: Employed for client-side state management across complex web applications.

## Deployment, Version Control & Tools

- **Git**: Version control system used for tracking code changes and maintaining project codebases.
- **Firebase & Vercel**: Deployment and hosting platforms used to publish static, serverless, and dynamic web applications.
- **cPanel**: Managed for hosting environments and server deployments.

Cartzi
======

Overview
--------

Cartzi is a full-stack e-commerce web platform designed to provide a modern online shopping experience.

Purpose
-------

The project was built to deliver a modern, scalable e-commerce infrastructure with reliable backend API management, smooth state synchronization, and secure transaction workflows.

Technologies
------------

*   Next.js
    
*   React
    
*   Zustand
    
*   Sanity CMS
    
*   Stripe
    
*   Clerk
    
*   Node.js / Express
    
*   MongoDB / MySQL
    

Features
--------

*   Secure user authentication and profile management using Clerk.
    
*   Dynamic product content management managed through Sanity CMS.
    
*   End-to-end shopping cart state tracking managed by Zustand.
    
*   Secure payment gateway processing through Stripe.
    
*   Order tracking, customer management, and backend product inventory management.
    

Responsibilities
----------------

Ahmed handled the full-stack development, including backend database schema designs for products and orders, API endpoints for payment processing, frontend state management setup, and authentication flow integration.

Challenges
----------

Designing efficient database schemas for handling dynamic product attributes, orders, and reviews while ensuring stable, real-time checkout processing under API payment limits.

What this project demonstrates
------------------------------

Demonstrates expertise in full-stack e-commerce architecture, third-party payment integration, headless CMS management, and centralized client-side state management.
